Message.Content: 20:45 Accident on AYE (towards Tuas) after Buona Vista with congestion till Lower Delta Rd. Avoid lanes 1 and 2. Bus services number 14, 33, 166, 197, 198, 97, 97e, 657, 963, 963e, 502 are delayed by up to 53 mins.

21:00-CCL-Planned train service adjustments from 17 January to 9 April 2026. Circle Line train service headways will be adjusted to facilitate tunnel strengthening works. Commuters should factor in additional travelling times of up to 30 minutes during peak hours, and consider alternative MRT lines and bus services. Please visit go.gov.sg/circle-line-tunnel-works for more information. For crowd status at Serangoon, please visit www.lta.gov.sg/content/ltagov/en/map/train-crowd-status.html
